note: Placeholders: {name} the monster, item, area or killer; {n} a level; {xp} experience. Item lines never name a quality (the identify reveal owns that). Every kind needs 3 or more variants; the choice is seeded by the event number, so a replay prints the same line.

boss: {name} is dead. The land is quieter.
The deed is done: {name} has fallen.
level: Level {n}. The wounds of the road fade.
death: Darkness: {name} was the last thing you saw.
first: A new thing in the world: {name}.
